title: Small Ace Trial power bump and Mid-Autumn shortcut art
summary: A small version. One Ace Trial ladder's first seven stages get higher power requirements, the Trail Map takes a new icon, one guild-task shortcut entry is trimmed, and four new assets arrive.
highlights: Ace Trial: the first seven stages of one ladder rise in required power, from 8,000 to 10,000 at the bottom through 500,000 to 700,000 at the top.
Trail Map takes a new icon.
ruins_challenge_new drops one sub-entry from its hero goto taskguild mapping for group 4.
New art: three Mid-Autumn shortcut banners and the Trail Map's own item icon.
